Hold [Reload] while at maximum Markov Chain stacks to lock the bayonet.

While Monte Carlo is held, it replaces your Melee Ability with a powerful glaive-like stab that deals <pve 2,772 /> <pvp [140] /> melee damage. Stab can reach up to 7 meters away and grants 50% Melee Ability Energy on hit.
